activity.notes: First royal voyage in 1534 under Francis I: Cartier sailed from Saint-Malo on 20 April, explored the Gulf of St. Lawrence and returned to Saint-Malo on 5 September. ATLAS stores this historically discrete voyage as a year-level 1534 Activity rather than bridging the gap to the later voyages.

sources.title: Jacques Cartier (1491–1557) — Dictionary of Canadian Biography
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of Canadian Biography identifies Cartier as the first explorer of the Gulf of St. Lawrence in 1534 and records his departure on 20 April 1534 and return to Saint-Malo on 5 September 1534.

sources.title: Cartier's voyages — Parks Canada
sources.citation_text: Parks Canada treats 1534 as Cartier's first of three distinct North American voyages.
